import React from 'react' import Dashbord1 from '../../media/IndustrialEnergy/Dashboard_1.jpg' import Dashbord2 from '../../media/IndustrialEnergy/Dashboard_2.jpg' import { ScrollUp } from '../../helpers/ScrollUp' import LeftText from './LeftText' import RightText from './RightText' import secured from '../../media/IndustrialEnergy/Secured data.jpg' import Excel from '../../media/IndustrialEnergy/excel2-svgrepo-com.svg' import Pdf from '../../media/IndustrialEnergy/pdf.svg' import gsheet from '../../media/IndustrialEnergy/gsheet.svg' import Circle from './Circle' const IemsDashBoard = ({ title }) => { // ScrollUp(); return ( <>

IEMS Dashboard

Fully Customizable Remote Monitoring Software.
Email/SMS Alerts & Notifications.
Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Device-Wise Reports.
Creation, Completion, and Update of Maintenance

Schedules Using Real-Time Mobile Camera Input.

Even History, Data Logs and comparative Data analytics.

Secured Data Storage on Cloud

Data Available for Download in CSV,Excel & PDF

Benefits of IEMS

Reduce utility bills by identifying and eliminating energy waste.
Enhance operational efficiency.
Reduce carbon footprint and ensure regulatory compliance.
Extend equipment lifespan.
Support strategic planning for future plant expansion.
) } export default IemsDashBoard
